Messages.Author: Enter your name here
Messages.Body:
After a minion has committed Diablorie, is the bloodhunt that can be called
a vote among the Methuselah's <1 vote per person> or is the vote among the
minions of the Methuselah's?

Thank you

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Neither - "vote among the Methuselahs" and "vote among the minions" are not
designations for any referendum in V:TES. All referenda involve the
Methuselahs (who can gain 1 vote each from Political Action card, and who
can also gain votes from the Edge and other effects in play) and the ready
vampires with votes.

See [6.3.3] and [6.5.6]

Messages.Author: KingJohann
Messages.Body:
Speaking of Diablarie and the accompanying blood hunt, I didn't notice any
reference to the Sabbat "Wyld Hunt" anywhere in the Sabbat War rulebooks.
Is this still a viable option for methuselahs?

This question came up during play recently when somebody attempted to call a
Wyld Hunt on Muaziz. If Wyld Hunts are still part of the game, is this an
option available?

Thanks for any help

DF

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
KingJohann <kingj...@aol.com> wrote in message
news:20010311233437...@ng-fo1.aol.com...

> Speaking of Diablarie and the accompanying blood hunt, I didn't notice any
> reference to the Sabbat "Wyld Hunt" anywhere in the Sabbat War rulebooks.
> Is this still a viable option for methuselahs?

In the CCG, a Wyld Hunt is identical to a Blood Hunt.
Therefore, the terminology "Wyld Hunt" has been dropped.
All vampires regardless of sect are subject to Blood Hunts when committing
diablerie.

> This question came up during play recently when somebody attempted to call
a
> Wyld Hunt on Muaziz. If Wyld Hunts are still part of the game, is this an
> option available?

No.
Muaziz is immune to punishment by vote for diablerie.
She can only be punished by the Sixth Tradition action card.

> Thanks for any help

Messages.Author: Andrew 'Wes' Weston
Messages.Body:
"KingJohann" <kingj...@aol.com>


There is no V:tES equivalent of the Wyld Hunt, though the fact that Blood
Hunts do not discriminate between Sabbat, Camarilla or Independent might
mean that it is meant to be the same thing.

It's only really the Camarilla that is opposed officially to diablerie
(except in some circumstances). The Sabbat would not have a problem with
diablerie, as long as it is against an enemy (ie. anyone who is not Sabbat)
or against a Sabbat foe that was defeated in Monomancy.

Personally, I'd love to see a card that reflects the Sabbat ambivalence
towards diablerie. It would be a nice edge for the Sabbies if they could
occasionally eat Cammies with impunity... (not just !Gangrel)

Cheers,
WES

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:

> Personally, I'd love to see a card that reflects the Sabbat ambivalence

> occasionally eat Cammies with impunity... (not just !Gangrel)

Fairly simple to do:

Chow Down on Evil (erm, Good....)
Unique Master
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire
Put this card in play. Place three counters on it. Tap this card
during a Bloodhunt referenda to cast X votes to save a ready Sabbat
vampire from being burned. Remove a counter when you do this. Burn
this card if it has zero counters on it.
